That calls super.query, and DataSourceWithBackend.query applies applyTemplateVariables to each target again with the same scopedVars and request.filters. addAdHocFilters/addLabelToQuery (modifyQuery.ts:147-214) does not dedupe, so with ad hoc filters set, each filter is added to the expression twice (e.g. {a="b", k="v", k="v"}, or two identical label filters after a parser). The already-interpolated expression is also parsed and rewritten again for every sub-request. The same double application exists in the shard path (shardQuerySplitting.ts:48-55), but runSplitQuery is where this change newly introduces it. The work is linear in the number of targets and sub-requests, so I found no unbounded or multiplicative cost.
